product_family: Generative AI voice + deepfake detection platform (Generate / Verify / Detect)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Resemble AI is currently in our SOC 2 Type 2 observation period. Our full audit report is expected to be available in August 2026.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: We are actively undergoing ISO 27001 certification and expect to be certified by the end of July 2026.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Resemble AI is fully GDPR compliant, with clear data processing practices and privacy-by-design principles built into our platform.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Resemble AI is HIPAA compliant, maintaining the safeguards required to handle protected health information responsibly.

privacy.ai_training_note: Resemble's Ethics page commits to user ownership of voice data 'without using it to train other models or selling it to third parties,' and requires explicit consent before voice cloning. The privacy policy itself does not restate the no-training pledge, so the strongest no-train assurance lives on the Ethics/commitments page and the customer terms rather than the core privacy policy.
privacy.data_region: United States (Services hosted and operated on U.S. servers per privacy policy)

security.name: Third-party penetration testing
security.value: Annual: a 3rd party is engaged to conduct a network and application penetration test of the production environment at least annually

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Service data transmitted over the internet is encrypted-in-transit

security.name: Continuous monitoring
security.value: Continuously monitored by Secureframe; documented controls across change management, availability, vulnerability management, incident response, network/access/physical security

security.name: Deployment options
security.value: On-prem or in the cloud; watermarking applied 'before it leaves your infrastructure' (supports air-gapped / self-hosted enterprise deployment)

security.name: Key subprocessors
security.value: Anthropic (internal tooling), Cerebrium (GPU inference), Cloudflare, GitHub, Apollo, Calendly, Figma, Fireflies, Gleap; full list + documents available via trust center request

products.name: Generate (Resemble TTS, Voice Creation, Audio, STS, Chatterbox models)
products.data_scope: Customer-supplied audio and voice data used to synthesize/clone voices; watermarked at creation. Requires consent of the individual whose voice is cloned. Voice data not used to train other models or sold.
products.notes: Core legacy product line; open Chatterbox model family. Voice cloning gated by a verbal consent system.

products.name: Verify (Resemble Identity, Watermarker, PerTh)
products.data_scope: Audio, image, and video files watermarked with a persistent invisible marker that travels with the file; can run on-prem before content leaves customer infrastructure.
products.notes: Marketed as EU AI Act compliant watermarking.

products.name: Detect (Resemble Detect, DETECT-3B-Omni, Meetings, Intelligence, Chrome extension)
products.data_scope: Customer-submitted audio, image, and video analyzed for deepfake/synthetic-media signals; benchmarked against 160+ generative models.
products.notes: Used for fraud/KYC, executive-impersonation, and media-integrity use cases across finance, telco, media, healthtech, public sector.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium + usage/subscription (Start free, self-serve tiers) with enterprise/contact-sales and API/SDK plans
compare.data_residency: United States (cloud); on-prem deployment available for enterprise

flags: SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 are both in progress, not yet issued (target Aug 2026 and Jul 2026 respectively) - display as 'in progress', not 'certified'.
HIPAA and GDPR are vendor self-attestations on the trust center; HIPAA has no third-party certificate by nature.
No public bug bounty program found; security testing relies on annual third-party pen test.
No-training pledge is strongest on the Ethics page and terms rather than the core privacy policy.
